name: io.github.AgentaFlow/whiteboxxai-mcp
title: WhiteBoxXAI
description: AI observability, explainability and governance: drift, fairness, ISO 42001, risk register.

environmentVariables.name: WHITEBOXXAI_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WhiteBoxXAI API key, generated from the dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: WHITEBOXXAI_MCP_API_BASE_URL

headers.name: X-WhiteBox-API-Key
headers.description: WhiteBoxXAI API key (raw value), required for Smithery and gateway proxying.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: your WhiteBoxXAI API key or personal JWT, as 'Bearer <token>'.
